name: tkhq-ff
description: Convenience scripts for running the backend and frontend together. backend/ and frontend/ stay independent npm projects with their own lockfiles — this is deliberately not an npm workspace.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.check: npm run format && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.format: prettier --check . && npm --prefix backend run format && npm --prefix frontend run format
scripts.format:write: prettier --write . && npm --prefix backend run format:write && npm --prefix frontend run format:write
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.lint:fix: npm --prefix backend run lint:fix && npm --prefix frontend run lint:fix
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
